# Now

> Reviewed 10 October 2026. Pilot day 30 of 30. See [current status](tool-library/status.md) for detail; this page is a dashboard, not another policy source.

## Tool Library Pilot

- **Current state:** 42 loans opened; 37 have reached their due date, 35 returned on time and two late; five remain current. See [metrics](tool-library/kb/pilot-metrics.md#10-october-snapshot).
- **What changed:** The [7 October review](tool-library/meetings/2026-10-07-pilot-review.md) kept the seven-day loan term and the day-five reminder. The paper-slip clarity problem is now handled by reading the due date aloud.
- **Blocked:** Three questions about returning at a different branch. No cross-branch return rule has been approved.
- **Next:** Jo collects desk feedback on the handoff card; Maya asks the policy owner about cross-branch returns; review the [open actions](tool-library/actions.md).
- **Resume from:** [Pilot overview](tool-library/README.md) · [current policy](tool-library/kb/borrowing-policy.md) · [latest review](tool-library/reviews/2026-10-08.md).

## Review rhythm

After each desk shift, add a short [journal entry](tool-library/journal/README.md), capture loose questions in the [inbox](inbox.md), and promote durable changes into the relevant KB page. The [decision log](tool-library/decisions.md) records settled choices and superseded drafts.
